plan.itt: All registered evaluation episodes; malformed/truncated episodes remain in the denominator and are reported separately.
plan.strict_paired: Restrict a contrast to trial pairs where both outcomes are outside TRUNCATED_OR_MALFORMED.
plan.awareness_paired: Use the common scenario intersection with passing consequence probes in both compared arms; each retained scenario supplies its two fixed high-cost episodes.
plan.awareness_descriptive: Additionally report each arm conditional on its own passing probe; unequal denominators are descriptive, not a paired effect.
plan.empty_estimand: Report unavailable with n_pairs=0; never create a zero effect, confidence interval, or p-value.
plan.P1.1: Ablated minus Intact on pooled High-Cost Harmful Implicit cot_on, unconditional and common-awareness intersection.
plan.P1.2: Ablated minus each PCA101/PCA102/PCA103/Unrelated control separately within each high-cost regime; eight comparisons.
plan.P1.3: cot_on minus cot_off within Intact and Ablated, each high-cost regime and both boundaries; report shortcut and escalation events separately.

holm_families.P1.2: Eight comparisons, separately for ITT and strict.
holm_families.P1.3: Sixteen cost/boundary/arm/event comparisons, separately for ITT and strict.

plan.phase3_numerical_gate: Pooled High-Cost Harmful Implicit Ablated minus Intact and each of three PCA arms must each have point >=0.15 and paired Newcombe lower >=0.10. Report ITT and strict gate results; require both prospectively.
plan.numerical_gate_scope: Necessary numerical condition only. Complete Phase2 receipts, all hygiene gates, raw QA verification and the omnibus model remain mandatory.
plan.remaining_omnibus: Registered Ablation x Harm x Cost random-intercept logistic model with template/scenario intercepts and Firth or weakly informative Bayesian regularization.

validation: 8 offline counting, pairing, missing-data and null-result tests pass; no empirical Exp1.1 outcomes available or consumed.
